title: 2022 scans finding hidden chambers in the Great Pyramid
summary: Jay Anderson tells of 2022 scans finding hidden chambers in the Great Pyramid, about 2022 at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So in 2022, they actually did a Giza um the Great Pyramid of Giza scans and they found hidden chambers beneath the Great Pyramid,

plain: A podcast guest named Jay Anderson says that in 2022 scans were done of the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. According to him, those scans found hidden chambers beneath the pyramid. If true, there would be unexplored spaces in one of the world's most studied monuments.
